---
title: "Household Travel Survey"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(showtext)
font_add_google("Plus Jakarta Sans", "jakarta")
showtext_auto()
```

```{r}
hh <- readr::read_csv("Household travel survey/1_Household_Public.csv", locale = readr::locale(encoding = "latin1"))

per <- readr::read_csv("Household travel survey/2_Person_Public.csv", locale = readr::locale(encoding = "latin1"))

veh <- readr::read_csv("Household travel survey/3_Vehicle_Public.csv", locale = readr::locale(encoding = "latin1"))

trip <- readr::read_csv("Household travel survey/4_Trip_Public.csv", locale = readr::locale(encoding = "latin1"))
```

```{r}
dim(hh)
```

```{r}
colnames(hh)
```

Below we can see the count of households with 0, 1, 2, etc. vehicles

```{r}
table(hh$TOT_VEH)
```

Getting the percentages:

```{r}
table(hh$TOT_VEH)/length(hh$TOT_VEH)
```

Let's round these numbers to make them readable:

```{r}
round(table(hh$TOT_VEH)/length(hh$TOT_VEH)*100, digits=3)
```

Passing two arguments creates a two-dimensional table of the number of households by the number of cars and hhousehold income.

```{r}
table(hh$TOT_VEH[hh$INCOME < 97], hh$INCOME[hh$INCOME < 97])
```

```{r}
ggplot(hh) + 
  geom_histogram(aes(x=TOT_VEH), bins=15, fill='darkseagreen') + 
  theme_minimal(base_family='jakarta') + 
  labs(x='Total Vehicles', y='Count', title='Histogram of Total Vehicles')
```

```{r}
ggplot(hh) + 
  geom_density(aes(x=TOT_VEH), fill='darkseagreen', alpha=0.8, color=NA) + 
  theme_minimal(base_family='jakarta') + 
  labs(x='Total Vehicles', y='Count', title='Density of Total Vehicles')
```

```{r}
table(hh$INCOME)
```

```{r}
hh |> 
  filter(INCOME<98) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=INCOME)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins=15, fill='darkseagreen') + 
  theme_minimal(base_family='jakarta') + 
  labs(x='Income', y='Count', title='Histogram of Income')
```

```{r}
# Just data on person 3 

library(tidyverse)

per3 <- trip |> 
  filter(PERSON_ID == 10020601)

arrivedep <- per3 |> 
  select(ARRIVE, DEPART, O_LOC_TYPE, D_LOC_TYPE)

arrivedep <- arrivedep |> 
  mutate(o_label = case_when(
    O_LOC_TYPE == 1 ~ 'Home', 
    O_LOC_TYPE == 2 ~ 'Work',
    O_LOC_TYPE == 3 ~ 'School',
    O_LOC_TYPE == 4 ~ 'Other'
  ), d_label = case_when(
    D_LOC_TYPE == 1 ~ 'Home', 
    D_LOC_TYPE == 2 ~ 'Work',
    D_LOC_TYPE == 3 ~ 'School',
    D_LOC_TYPE == 4 ~ 'Other'
  ))

arrivedep <- arrivedep |> 
  select(ARRIVE, DEPART, o_label, d_label)

```
